inputs.text: NO TEXT OR LOGO OF ANY KIND. Minimal wide 16:10 launcher background for a playful cartridge-era science-fiction action game. The visual motif is a single large iconic beveled cobalt-blue mechanical cube whose front bears the game's signature 'Clancer' expression: TWO simple dark vertical oval eyes side by side, and directly below them ONE separate open vertical oval mouth -- a cheerful, slightly surprised 'oh' face. The mouth is a clean oval hole, NOT a smile, NOT a grin, NOT a curved line; the eyes are plain ovals, NOT happy arcs. All three features are smooth simple embossed holes, evenly spaced, exactly like the faces on the blocks in Mischief Makers. Place the hero cube in the lower-left quadrant, partially cropped by the bottom edge, with a few smaller cubes floating behind it, each showing the same two-oval-eyes-and-one-oval-mouth face. Surround the hero with two sweeping golden-orange energy arcs and sparse four-point sparkles. Abstract geometric alien machinery recedes into a deep burgundy, violet and midnight-blue background. Polished cel-shaded 3D shapes, bold clean silhouettes, subtle grain, playful 1990s console-box atmosphere. COMPOSITION IS CRITICAL: leave the upper-left quarter calm and mostly empty for the title; keep the entire rightmost 42 percent extremely dark, quiet, low-contrast and almost empty for a menu. Full bleed. Background art only. Absolutely no smiles, no grins, no teeth, no people, no words, letters, typography, logo, watermark, UI, border, or busy right side.
